journal.sentenceEn: The team published their findings in the journal Science this month.
journal.translationZh: 该团队于本月在《科学》杂志上发表了他们的研究成果。
journal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

journal.sentenceEn: In a paper published in the Journal of Child Psychology and Psychiatry, researchers said that the western nuclear family was a recent invention which broke with evolutionary history.
journal.translationZh: 在《儿童心理学与精神病学杂志》发表的一篇论文中，研究人员指出，西方核心家庭是近代的产物，它打破了人类的进化史。
journal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

journal.sentenceEn: The scientific community measures the quality of those papers in a number of ways, including the perceived quality of the journal (as reflected by the title's impact factor) and the number of citations a specific paper accumulates.
journal.translationZh: 科学界通过多种方式衡量这些论文的质量，包括期刊的公认质量（体现在该刊的影响因子上）以及特定论文积累的引用次数。
journal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

journal.sentenceEn: Each year researchers publish millions of papers in more than 30,000 journals .
journal.translationZh: 研究人员每年在三万多种期刊上发表数百万篇论文。
journal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

journal.sentenceEn: The problem is rampant in Scopus, a citation database, which includes a high number of the new "international" journals .
journal.translationZh: 这一问题在Scopus（一个引文数据库）中十分猖獗，该数据库收录了大量新的“国际”期刊。
journal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

journal.sentenceEn: It hinders the growth of "international" journals .
journal.translationZh: 这阻碍了“国际”期刊的发展。

justice.sentenceEn: And it carries "significant repercussions for water quality and flood control throughout the United States," as Justice Brett Kavanaugh observed.
justice.translationZh: 正如布雷特·卡瓦诺大法官所指出的，这一裁决“将对全美国的水质和防洪产生重大影响”。
justice.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

justice.sentenceEn: That means more battles like the one now going on between the Justice Department and California, which enacted a tough net neutrality law in the wake of the FCC's abdication.
justice.translationZh: 这意味着将会有更多类似目前司法部与加利福尼亚州之间正在进行的斗争，后者在联邦通信委员会放弃监管后颁布了一项严格的网络中立性法律。
justice.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

justice.sentenceEn: Justice Anthony Kennedy wrote that the previous decisions were flawed.
justice.translationZh: 安东尼·肯尼迪大法官写道，先前的裁决存在缺陷。
justice.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

justice.sentenceEn: "Each year the physical presence rule becomes further removed from economic reality and results in significant revenue losses to the States," he wrote in an opinion joined by four other justices .
justice.translationZh: 他在一份有另外四位大法官联署的意见书中写道：“实体存在规则每年都愈发脱离经济现实，给各州造成了重大的收入损失。”
justice.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

justice.sentenceEn: On which of the following did the Justices agree, according to Paragraph 4?
justice.translationZh: 根据第四段，大法官们在以下哪项上达成了一致？

justice.sentenceEn: Everyone should try hard to promote social justice .
justice.translationZh: 每个人都应该努力促进社会公正。

judge.sentenceEn: But Judge Patricia Millett rightly argued in a concurring opinion that "the result is unhinged from the realities of modern broadband service," and said Congress or the Supreme Court could intervene to "avoid trapping Internet regulation in technological anachronism."
judge.translationZh: 但帕特里夏·米利特法官在其协同意见中正确指出，"这一结果脱离了现代宽带服务的实际情况"，并表示国会或最高法院可进行干预，以"避免将互联网监管困在技术时代错误之中"。
judge.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

judge.sentenceEn: She found similar interference when participants watched 15-second clips of pairs of people and judged whether they were strangers, friends, or dating partners.
judge.translationZh: 当参与者观看15秒的双人片段并判断他们是陌生人、朋友还是约会对象时，她发现了类似的干扰现象。
judge.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

judge.sentenceEn: We're fairly good at judging people based on first impressions, thin slices of experience ranging from a glimpse of a photo to five-minute interaction, and deliberation can be not only extraneous but intrusive.
judge.translationZh: 我们相当擅长根据第一印象来判断他人——这种快速的经验片段可以是匆匆一瞥的照片，也可以是五分钟的互动——而深思熟虑不仅多余，甚至会造成干扰。
judge.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

judge.sentenceEn: A judge has now overruled the city's decision to stop levying fines, ordering them reinstated.
judge.translationZh: 一名法官现已否决了该市停止征收罚款的决定，并下令恢复罚款。
judge.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

judge.sentenceEn: The high court's decision said the judge in Mr. McDonnell's trial failed to tell a jury that it must look only at his "official acts," or the former governor's decisions on "specific" and "unsettled" issues related to his duties.
judge.translationZh: 最高法院的裁决指出，麦克唐纳案的主审法官未能告知陪审团，他们只需考量麦克唐纳的“公务行为”，即这位前州长在与其职责相关的“具体”且“未决”问题上的决策。
judge.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

judge.sentenceEn: It has been opposed by a judge .
judge.translationZh: 一位法官已否决了这一决定。

journalist.sentenceEn: "I don't believe that the legal protection would have happened in the time frame that it did without those images," says Heather Hansen, journalist and author of Prophets and Moguls, Rangers and Rogues, Bison and Bears: 100 Years of the National Park Service.
journalist.translationZh: 记者兼《先知与大亨、护林员与流浪者、野牛与熊：国家公园管理局百年史》一书作者希瑟·汉森表示：“我认为，如果没有这些影像资料，黄石公园的法律保护不会在当时那个时间框架内实现。”

journalist.sentenceEn: What political journalist , what party whip, would not want to know the makeup of the WhatsApp groups in which Theresa May's enemies are currently plotting?
journalist.translationZh: 哪个政治记者、哪个党鞭不想知道特蕾莎·梅的政敌们目前正在哪些WhatsApp群组里密谋策划呢？
journalist.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

journalist.sentenceEn: Journalists are known to have hacked the phones of up to 5,500 people.
journalist.translationZh: 据悉，记者们已入侵多达5500人的手机。
journalist.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

journalist.sentenceEn: Ms Brooks may or may not have had suspicions about how her journalists got their stories, but she asked no questions, gave no instructions – nor received traceable, recorded answers.
journalist.translationZh: 布鲁克斯女士或许对其记者获取新闻素材的方式有所怀疑，也可能毫不知情，但她从未提出过任何问题，未给出过任何指示——也从未收到过可追踪、有记录的答复。
journalist.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

journalist.sentenceEn: Many papers stayed afloat by pushing journalists overboard.
journalist.translationZh: 许多报纸通过裁员记者来维持运营。
journalist.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

journalist.translationZh: 新闻记者需要更严格的行业监管。

jury.sentenceEn: The high court's decision said the judge in Mr. McDonnell's trial failed to tell a jury that it must look only at his "official acts," or the former governor's decisions on "specific" and "unsettled" issues related to his duties.
jury.translationZh: 最高法院的裁决指出，麦克唐纳案的主审法官未能告知陪审团，他们只需考量麦克唐纳的“公务行为”，即这位前州长在与其职责相关的“具体”且“未决”问题上的决策。
jury.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

jury.sentenceEn: This practice was justified by the claim that women were needed at home, and it kept juries unrepresentative of women through the 1960s.
jury.translationZh: 这种做法的理由是女性需要留在家中，这使得整个20世纪60年代的陪审团都无法代表女性群体。
jury.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

jury.sentenceEn: In the landmark 1975 decision Taylor v. Louisiana, the Supreme Court extended the requirement that juries be representative of all parts of the community to the state level.
jury.translationZh: 在具有里程碑意义的1975年泰勒诉路易斯安那州案判决中，最高法院将陪审团应代表社会各阶层这一要求扩展到了州一级。
jury.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

jury.sentenceEn: The jury is also said to be the best surviving example of direct rather than representative democracy.
jury.translationZh: 陪审团也被认为是现存最能体现直接民主而非代议制民主的典范。
jury.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

jury.sentenceEn: Although the Supreme Court of the United States had prohibited intentional racial discrimination in jury selection as early as the 1880 case of Strauder v. West Virginia, the practice of selecting so-called elite or blue-ribbon juries provided a convenient way around this and other antidiscrimination laws.
jury.translationZh: 尽管美国最高法院早在1880年Strauder诉西弗吉尼亚州一案中就禁止了陪审团遴选过程中蓄意的种族歧视，但挑选所谓精英陪审团或蓝带陪审团的做法却为规避这一规定及其他反歧视法律提供了便利途径。
jury.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

jury.sentenceEn: Juries tended to find fault with the compensations companies promised.
jury.translationZh: 陪审团往往会对公司承诺的赔偿挑刺。
jury.paperLabel: 考研英语 1999 英语（未分卷）

justify.sentenceEn: There will be no charge and you will never be asked to justify or explain yourself; you will simply be welcomed in, offered help if you need it, and left alone if you do not.
justify.translationZh: 此处不收取任何费用，也绝不会要求你进行辩解或说明；我们只会简单地欢迎你，在你需要时提供帮助，并在你不需要时不去打扰。
justify.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

justify.sentenceEn: Yet mediocrity is no longer enough to justify a dismissal.
justify.translationZh: 然而，仅仅是平庸已不足以成为解雇的正当理由。
justify.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

justify.translationZh: 相反，解雇必须有正当理由。
justify.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

justify.sentenceEn: How can the train operators possibly justify yet another increase to rail passenger fares?
justify.translationZh: 铁路运营商又一次提高客运票价，这究竟如何说得过去？
justify.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

justify.sentenceEn: It is curious that Stephen Koziatek feels almost as though he has to justify his efforts to give his students a better future.
justify.translationZh: 斯蒂芬·科齐亚特克（Stephen Koziatek）觉得自己几乎需要为努力给学生创造更美好的未来而辩解，这真是件奇怪的事。
justify.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

justify.sentenceEn: A doctor's medication is no longer justified by his intentions.
justify.translationZh: 医生用药的合理性不再由其意图决定。
justify.paperLabel: 考研英语 2002 英语（未分卷）

judgment.sentenceEn: Critically, another group was asked to spend a minute writing down reasons for their judgment , before giving the rating.
judgment.translationZh: 关键的是，另一组参与者被要求在给出评分前，先用一分钟写下自己做出判断的理由。
judgment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

judgment.sentenceEn: At first glance this might seem like a strength that grants the ability to make judgments which are unbiased by external factors.
judgment.translationZh: 乍一看，这似乎是一种优势，使人能够做出不受外部因素影响的判断。
judgment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

judgment.sentenceEn: The ethical judgments of the Supreme Court justices have become an important issue recently.
judgment.translationZh: 最近，最高法院大法官的道德判断已成为一个重要议题。
judgment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

judgment.sentenceEn: That kind of activity makes it less likely that the court's decisions will be accepted as impartial judgments .
judgment.translationZh: 这类活动会使法院的裁决不太可能被视为公正的判断。
judgment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

judgment.sentenceEn: Yet bank shares rose and the changes enhance what one lobbying group politely calls "the use of judgment by management."
judgment.translationZh: 然而银行股价上涨了，这些修改也强化了某个游说团体委婉所称的“管理层判断力的运用”。
judgment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

judgment.sentenceEn: He was willing to assert that "I have a fair share of invention, and of common sense or judgment , such as every fairly successful lawyer or doctor must have, but not, I believe, in any higher degree."
judgment.translationZh: 他乐于承认：“我具备一定的创造力，也拥有普通常识或判断力，如同每一位相当成功的律师或医生所必须具备的那样，但我认为，自己的这些能力并不比他们强多少。”
judgment.paperLabel: 考研英语 2008 英语（未分卷）
judgment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第10句

journalism.sentenceEn: Before applying for university I told everyone that I would study journalism , because writing was, and still is, one of my favourite activities.
journalism.translationZh: 申请大学前，我告诉所有人我会学习新闻专业，因为写作过去是、现在仍然是我最喜欢的活动之一。
journalism.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

journalism.sentenceEn: Among the commission's 51 members are top-tier-university presidents, scholars, lawyers, judges, and business executives, as well as prominent figures from diplomacy, filmmaking, music and journalism .
journalism.translationZh: 该委员会的51名成员包括顶尖大学校长、学者、律师、法官、企业高管，以及外交、电影制作、音乐和新闻领域的知名人士。
journalism.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

journalism.sentenceEn: All around the world, lawyers generate more hostility than the members of any other profession – with the possible exception of journalism .
journalism.translationZh: 在全世界范围内，律师比其他任何职业的从业者都更易招致敌意——新闻业或许是个例外。
journalism.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

journalism.sentenceEn: These men believed in journalism as a calling, and were proud to be published in the daily press.
journalism.translationZh: 这些人将新闻业视为一项神圣的职业，并为能在日报上发表文章而自豪。
journalism.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

journalism.sentenceEn: "So few authors have brains enough or literary gift enough to keep their own end up in journalism ," Newman wrote, "that I am tempted to define 'journalism' as 'a term of contempt applied by writers who are not read to writers who are'."
journalism.translationZh: 纽曼曾写道：“拥有足够头脑或文学天赋能在新闻界站稳脚跟的作者寥寥无几，以至于我不禁想把‘新闻写作’定义为‘那些无人问津的作者对当红作家的轻蔑之词’。”
journalism.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

journalism.sentenceEn: Writers are likely to be tempted into journalism .
journalism.translationZh: 作家们很可能会禁不住诱惑投身新闻业。

journey.sentenceEn: True: for more than 80 pre-digital years, linear speech broadcasting brought the gift of serendipity, random enlivening of a car journey or dull manual task.
journey.translationZh: 的确，在数字时代到来前的 80 多年里，线性广播带来了意外发现的乐趣，为驾车出行或枯燥的体力活增添了随机的活力。
journey.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

journey.sentenceEn: Indeed, it was frequently the first stop for merchants looking to sell their wares and stock up on supplies for their own journeys .
journey.translationZh: 事实上，这里往往是商人们寻找销售商品并为自己的旅程补充 supplies 的第一站。
journey.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

journey.sentenceEn: The journey officially began in Ogden, Utah, on June 8, 1871.
journey.translationZh: 此次考察于1871年6月8日在犹他州奥格登正式启程。

journey.sentenceEn: As the latest crop of students pen their undergraduate application form and weigh up their options, it may be worth considering just how the point, purpose and value of a degree has changed and what Generation Z need to consider as they start the third stage of their educational journey .
journey.translationZh: 当最新一批学生正在填写本科申请表并权衡各种选择时，或许值得思考一下：学位的意义、目的和价值究竟发生了怎样的变化？以及Z世代在开启他们教育旅程的第三阶段时需要考虑哪些因素？
journey.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

journey.sentenceEn: Many of the ships were lost in storms, many passengers died of disease, and infants rarely survived the journey .
journey.translationZh: 许多船只在风暴中失事，许多乘客死于疾病，婴儿则很少能在旅途中存活。
journey.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

journey.sentenceEn: And afterwards, when we come to think back on it, we can't remember the journey well because we didn't pay much attention to it.
journey.translationZh: 而事后回想起来时，我们却不太记得这段路程，因为当时并未给予太多关注。
journey.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句
